tests.title: Cross-tenant launch impersonation
tests.setup: Two synthetic tenants with independent operational grants.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Tenant A supplies tenant B identifiers in launch request.
assertions: No B identity, mount, grant or secret is issued.
Denial occurs at verified launcher/authority, not only UI.
tests.positive_control: A valid A launch reaches ready.

tests.title: Role self-assertion
tests.setup: Unprivileged workbench with bootstrap route only.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Request credential-broker or approver role through labels/CSR/header.
assertions: Identity service rejects the unapproved role.
No parent registration API is exposed.
tests.positive_control: Approved workbench identity is issued.

tests.title: Workload API forwarding confused deputy
tests.setup: Selected SPIRE/identity adapter and two guests behind any local proxy.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Guest A requests or races identity intended for B or proxy host.
assertions: Peer is mapped to actual launch/key/boot.
General Workload API or proxy SVID cannot be used as B.
tests.positive_control: Both separately authorized identities work.

tests.title: Copied valid quote and bootstrap-key substitution
tests.setup: Two parents with different admitted boot keys.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Reuse another parent quote or replace issuer key after verification.
assertions: Key/nonce/instance/release mismatch rejects admission.
No operational key is released.
tests.positive_control: Correct fresh evidence admits only its bound key.

tests.title: CID and process-ID reuse
tests.setup: Destroy A, reuse routing identifiers for a new guest.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Present old launch binding/certificate or stale routing record.
assertions: Old boot has no active authority.
New guest gets no inherited secret.
tests.positive_control: Freshly admitted new boot works.

tests.title: Issuer registration and trust-bundle replacement
tests.setup: Accepted trust domain with current keeper delegation.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Use ordinary host admin path or child input to install a CA/registration.
assertions: Unaccepted issuer/role/tenant binding is refused.
Issuer access does not stand in for owner delegation.
tests.positive_control: Owner/release-authorized bundle transition works.

tests.title: Renewal and clock rollback
tests.setup: Long-lived authenticated stream and expiring grant.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Delay control updates; move wall clock backward; restore old elapsed state.
assertions: No lease/grant extension from clock rollback.
Sensitive operation pauses when freshness is unprovable.
tests.positive_control: Fresh control and legitimate identity renewal restore permitted access.

tests.title: Identity secret absent from pristine template
tests.setup: Prepare snapshot of an unassigned template.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Search test image/memory fixture for seeded identity keys/tickets/grants; branch twice.
assertions: No tenant or workload identity material is reused.
Branches require independent activation.
tests.positive_control: Both freshly activated synthetic branches can run own tasks.

tests.title: Wrong service or trust domain
tests.setup: mTLS service with an exact expected peer.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Present valid cert from another role/domain/public CA or CN-only identity.
assertions: Handshake/application admission is refused.
No public-PKI fallback.
tests.positive_control: Exact accepted service peer succeeds.

tests.title: Copied capability from another workload
tests.setup: Two valid browser instances with separate keys and boots.
tests.exercise_or_fault: B presents A use grant over B mTLS channel.
assertions: Recipient proof-of-possession mismatch rejects.
Secret use count does not move to B.
tests.positive_control: A can use its current grant once.

tests.title: Replay, timeout and concurrent duplicate RPC
tests.setup: Identified approved fake-provider send.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Replay request across connections and race same operation; drop response after acceptance.
assertions: Only one logical external action is admitted under existing dispatcher rules.
Unknown result remains attached to same operation.
tests.positive_control: Read/reconcile recovers provider receipt.

tests.title: TLS early data and unsafe resumption
tests.setup: Selected production RPC/TLS implementations.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Attempt 0-RTT or restore old TLS resumption material after revocation.
assertions: No early-data dispatch.
Disabled resumption or complete current-binding validation is proven.
tests.positive_control: Fresh full handshake under current policy works.

tests.title: Request/stream exhaustion
tests.setup: Authorized small request plus hostile concurrent stream.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Oversized decoded message, compressed expansion, nesting, headers, queue and stalled chunks.
assertions: Resource limits refuse hostile inputs and release buffers.
Other tenant latency/backlog remains within recorded bound.
tests.positive_control: Valid bounded transfer completes.

tests.title: UDS/vsock proxy identity confusion
tests.setup: Byte bridge and optional explicit terminating proxy.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Send a forged original-user header through the proxy.
assertions: No caller identity accepted from header alone.
Terminating proxy uses an explicit narrow delegation contract or is refused.
tests.positive_control: End-to-end TLS byte bridge preserves expected identity.

tests.title: Stream revocation
tests.setup: Authorized data stream publishing committed revisions.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Withdraw source/data permission while stream remains open.
assertions: New disallowed data is not released.
Measured refusal satisfies freshness contract.
tests.positive_control: Unrelated authorized subscription continues.

tests.title: Keeper/workload self-approval
tests.setup: Real approval verifier with synthetic human and keeper keys.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Validly sign approval with keeper/agent key.
assertions: No approval spend or provider dispatch.
No alternate internal RPC permits self-promotion.
tests.positive_control: Human approver signs exact operation and it executes once.

tests.title: Payload and audience substitution
tests.setup: Approved send for account/channel/payload X.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Swap account, recipient, body or destination while keeping operation handle.
assertions: Mismatch rejects before effect.
Same-domain different audience is not accepted.
tests.positive_control: Original unchanged approved payload succeeds.

tests.title: Delegation widening
tests.setup: Task with read-only source scope.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Ask child, policy adapter or capability issuer for write/export/new owner kinds.
assertions: Intersection cannot widen.
Unknown critical kind/field fails closed.
tests.positive_control: Permitted bounded read works.

tests.title: Policy evaluation failure
tests.setup: Selected embedded or existing policy evaluator.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Cause type/schema/unknown-field errors in a forbid or context.
assertions: Critical diagnostics cause denial, not accidental allow.
One evaluator matches existing verifier semantics.
tests.positive_control: Well-formed permitted policy still passes.

tests.title: Stale configuration and update ordering
tests.setup: Two services at different policy acknowledgements.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Widen policy locally without owner commit; withhold narrowing from one receiver.
assertions: No uncommitted broadening.
Stale sensitive receiver pauses after freshness bound.
tests.positive_control: Committed accepted update applies and is shown accurately.

tests.title: Turn ceiling when keeper wakes
tests.setup: Phone/browser device-limited Omi turn.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Keeper becomes ready; submit old job-bus connector action.
assertions: Existing turn gains no connectors/leases.
New proposal revalidates source/version/current authority.
tests.positive_control: Explicit new admitted keeper turn uses allowed connection.

tests.title: Secret enumeration and raw signing
tests.setup: Omi and workbench valid identities.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Try GetSecret, SignAnyBytes, arbitrary provider URL and keeper filesystem paths.
assertions: No such generic authority path.
Operational DEK and other credential records inaccessible.
tests.positive_control: Typed allowed data query and provider operation work.

tests.title: Exact fill recipient and lease
tests.setup: Owner-saved test password and authorized browser A.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Browser B, wrong boot, expired lease or workbench tries ConsumeFill.
assertions: No plaintext delivered to wrong recipient.
Use handle cannot be replayed across lease generations.
tests.positive_control: A completes permitted fixture sign-in.

tests.title: Navigation/frame race
tests.setup: Hostile fixture changes frame/document after validation.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Navigate or replace frame before injected fill.
assertions: Guard invalidates fill or binds safely to original accepted document.
Wrong origin/field receives no secret.
tests.positive_control: Stable correct sign-in page succeeds.

tests.title: Credential trace leakage
tests.setup: Distinct canary passwords, TOTP seed and API token.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Execute sign-in and trigger errors, screenshots, telemetry, shell and CLI paths.
assertions: No canary in model/tool output, global logs/env/arguments/clipboard or shared traces.
Expected credential recipient/upstream exposure documented.
tests.positive_control: Private owner receipt reports non-secret outcome.

tests.title: Owner-only credential changes
tests.setup: Existing saved credential at version 1.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Keeper tries put/delete/export or changes allowed domains.
assertions: Actual endpoint requires owner authority and exact version.
Operational use cannot mutate policy.
tests.positive_control: Owner-authorized replacement succeeds and versioned uses revalidate.

tests.title: Delayed OAuth refresh release
tests.setup: Old owner refresh pending at fake token server.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Transfer owner, then deliver new access token; crash around issuance record/return.
assertions: Stale generation cannot receive newly unaccounted usable token.
Outstanding exposure prevents premature safe-point declaration.
tests.positive_control: Fresh current-owner refresh records expiry before exposure.

tests.title: Cross-connection protocol state
tests.setup: Two sessions on same network and another provider.
tests.exercise_or_fault: One worker requests other session record/key or publishes as it.
assertions: No other session custody/publication scope.
No general vault/sync key release.
tests.positive_control: Own session receive/commit/ACK works.

tests.title: Placeholder semantics and reflection
tests.setup: Synthetic compatibility API with header substitution and echo endpoint.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Change host/method/path/body; reflect authenticated header in response.
assertions: Binding and dispatcher scope enforced; unknown semantics refused.
Reflected secret cannot support a claim of DLP; exposure triggers explicit containment evidence.
tests.positive_control: Bound authorized compatibility request succeeds.

tests.title: CLI/model credential custody
tests.setup: Chosen CLI/model adapter with controlled login state.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Branch workers, refresh concurrently, try alternate provider or token read.
assertions: No refresh-token clones or hidden route fallback.
Unsupported custody mode unavailable.
tests.positive_control: Single authorized credential owner completes an allowed task.

tests.title: Network floor before workload
tests.setup: First boot, graceful/unclean restart and launcher restart.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Send immediately on all interfaces before policy readiness.
assertions: No forbidden packet leaves before enforcement.
Secret release follows admitted network identity state.
tests.positive_control: Permitted route opens only after readiness.

tests.title: Interceptor missing and administrative bypass
tests.setup: Accepted external-interceptor worker.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Kill interceptor, rebind, invoke no-interceptor update or alternative implicit start.
assertions: No direct fallback.
Untrusted workload cannot change required mode.
tests.positive_control: Valid restored interceptor allows approved egress.

tests.title: IP/DNS and alternate-protocol bypass
tests.setup: Guest with bounded provider egress.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Use IPv6, literals, metadata IP, loopback, private subnets, DNS rebinding, UDP/QUIC/WebRTC and alternate port.
assertions: Policy denies undeclared traffic independent of proxy variables.
Intended provider TLS identity remains checked.
tests.positive_control: Declared connector protocol continues.

tests.title: Credential CA scope
tests.setup: Guest with scoped interception CA and ordinary service TLS.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Use CA for unapproved host or install it in keeper trust path.
assertions: Unexpected destination/issuer is refused.
No global trust-store mutation.
tests.positive_control: Approved compatibility host and genuine unrelated TLS both work.

tests.title: Interception and checkpoint compatibility
tests.setup: Pinned smolvm with chosen egress mode.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Try unsupported external-interceptor branch/checkpoint launch.
assertions: Unsupported combination stays unavailable.
Patch enabling it requires whole restore/network identity test.
tests.positive_control: Supported normal launch works with enforcement.

tests.title: Pristine versus dirty pool reuse
tests.setup: Browser used with credentials and files.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Delete profile directory and offer same instance as pristine.
assertions: Instance is destroyed or quarantined, never reused by cosmetic cleanup.
Accepted output survives destruction.
tests.positive_control: Fresh unassigned instance admits next user.

tests.title: Snapshot with live identity and TCP state
tests.setup: Authorized worker snapshot taken during a task.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Restore while old process remains live.
assertions: Restored network remains denied before new identity/current authority.
No duplicate profile/connection lease or inherited channel authority.
tests.positive_control: Explicit fenced original-to-successor protocol can resume.

tests.title: Paused sender after final check
tests.setup: Existing dispatcher approved fake-provider action.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Freeze executor after final check before network send; attempt ownership transition and thaw.
assertions: External observer sees declared fencing behavior.
Any in-flight uncertainty retained; database denial alone insufficient.
tests.positive_control: Orderly quiesce and current owner send succeeds.

tests.title: Profile write-back loss
tests.setup: Leased signed-in profile version and staged update.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Lose reply/kill before promotion; request a new lease.
assertions: Old accepted version retained with suspect-session policy.
No two active owners or silent stale cookie reuse.
tests.positive_control: Verified promotion permits later lease.

tests.title: Issuer/witness outage
tests.setup: Current sessions, cached records and pending approval.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Block issuer/witness until freshness expires.
assertions: No new sensitive authority, approval spend or token release.
Cached authorized reads behave as specified, not a global destructive reset.
tests.positive_control: After current recovery proof, permitted work resumes.

tests.title: Release rollback
tests.setup: Account on new accepted policy and key generation.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Roll transport binary or data disk back to old state.
assertions: Unsupported reader/old generation refuses without deleting data.
No permissive fallback or parallel runner.
tests.positive_control: Compatible safe reader uses current state.

tests.title: Cross-host handoff
tests.setup: One authorized keeper/connection and destination on another machine.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Lose quiesce/transfer acknowledgement, retry over different transport.
assertions: No implicit authority transfer by transport or timeout.
Same operation/connection identity retained.
tests.positive_control: Completed exact-state handoff activates one successor.

tests.title: Archive/protocol commit failures
tests.setup: Actual selected SDK or faithful durable receive queue fixture.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Crash at archive, protocol and acknowledgement boundaries including duplicate redelivery.
assertions: No acknowledged data lost in tested contract.
Already advanced crypto state not blindly re-decrypted/replayed.
tests.positive_control: Normal ingestion preserves original source/IDs.

tests.title: Selective archive rollback and legal pruning
tests.setup: Current hostd commitment with recent archive and recovery chunks.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Restore older SQLite only, then separately perform authorized retention pruning.
assertions: Old missing acknowledged archive detected/recovered without protocol rewind.
Legal pruning is distinguishable.
tests.positive_control: Current snapshot/backup restores cleanly.

tests.title: Thin cache and erasure lineage
tests.setup: Partial client cache, pending edit and source-derived Omi records.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Evict cache, erase source, restore old checkpoint.
assertions: Eviction does not become deletion; pending edit preserved.
Erased/unauthorized source is not reused through transcript/index/checkpoint.
tests.positive_control: Authorized retained source is still searchable with honest coverage.

tests.title: Private data telemetry canaries
tests.setup: Canaries in prompts/messages/URLs/credentials/errors.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Run normal and failing tasks, inspect every shared exporter and trace baggage.
assertions: No forbidden content in fleet outputs.
Allowlist rejects arbitrary metadata fields.
tests.positive_control: Aggregate role/outcome metrics remain useful.

tests.title: Guest spoofs billing identity
tests.setup: Two tenants with measured workloads.
tests.exercise_or_fault: A emits B tenant/task/resource labels and fake counters.
assertions: Trusted collector labels from launch mapping.
Self observations distinguished from authoritative counters.
tests.positive_control: Honest self observations can supplement trusted measurements.

tests.title: Hierarchical accounting reconciliation
tests.setup: Host, parent VM and child workload counters with known nested boundaries.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Aggregate parent plus children and inject counter reset/missing sample.
assertions: No double-counted total; null is not zero; reset handled.
Allocation residual and quality exported explicitly.
tests.positive_control: Independent direct totals reconcile on synthetic trace.

tests.title: Observer overhead
tests.setup: Paired workload with approved metrics sampling variants.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Compare instrumented runs while holding security and workload constant.
assertions: Observer CPU/memory/storage/network included.
No exclusion of metric service from cost.
tests.positive_control: Low-cost valid sampling preserves oracle visibility.

tests.title: Tail latency under saturation
tests.setup: Seeded open-loop arrivals and closed-loop user flows.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Increase load through capacity, with queued and refused work.
assertions: Latency includes scheduled arrival delay.
Drops/errors/unknown outcomes in denominator; no percentile averaging.
tests.positive_control: Below-capacity successful throughput is reported.

tests.title: Noisy neighbor fairness
tests.setup: Two small accounts plus heavy import/build account.
tests.exercise_or_fault: CPU, memory, I/O and network stress by heavy account.
assertions: Interactive and ingestion thresholds measured under admitted load.
No sole-copy loss/OOM hidden as successful shedding.
tests.positive_control: Resource policy restores bounded service fairness.

tests.title: Secure cost comparison
tests.setup: Equal workload/model/retention/security baseline and candidate.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Try omitting standby, failed starts, backups or identity overhead; change model quality silently.
assertions: Comparison marked invalid or separate assumption.
Fully allocated and marginal views separated; unknown price is null.
tests.positive_control: Complete equal-contract comparison reports cost range.

tests.title: Hardware-context release
tests.setup: Actual confidential host with tracked active/pause/deallocate states.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Pause, checkpoint, stop and destroy workloads/outer guests.
assertions: Real resource/context release recorded, not inferred from process status.
Hardware limit not confused with application key count.
tests.positive_control: Fresh allocation works after confirmed release.

tests.title: Cohort loss and reconnect storm
tests.setup: Declared shared-CVM cohort and failover headroom.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Lose parent host; reconnect clients/connectors simultaneously.
assertions: Availability and cost include replacement/quarantine/headroom.
No duplicated mutable session, task or approval.
tests.positive_control: Orderly restored permitted cohort reaches readiness.

tests.title: Measured versus simulated evidence
tests.setup: Results with mixed model/provider/hardware fidelity.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Attempt to publish simulated speed or estimated cost as measured confidential result.
assertions: Schema/report labels preserve each fidelity and assumptions.
Missing supporting hardware evidence blocks G2/G5 claim.
tests.positive_control: Properly labeled analytical sensitivity can still be published.

tests.title: Ordinary-host secret boundary
tests.setup: Real CVM deployment with selected interception/issuance topology.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Inspect outside-host configs/logs/network dumps using synthetic secret canaries.
assertions: No plaintext secret/operational root is intentionally outside accepted TEE.
Metadata/parent trust residual is documented.
tests.positive_control: Inside authorized endpoint can complete test use.

tests.title: Free and offline predecessor preservation
tests.setup: Free web-only, desktop keeper and cloud-unready accounts.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Enable internal-layer rollout and disconnect keeper.
assertions: Native phone Matrix and required free portals remain.
No free account forced into hosted custody or new model route.
tests.positive_control: Supported keeper-backed thin path works after ready.

tests.title: Per-cell compatibility gate
tests.setup: One validated Linux transport/egress/identity profile.
tests.exercise_or_fault: Attempt untested Windows/Cua/shared-CVM/snapshot combination.
assertions: No inherited approval from another deployment cell.
Capability explicitly unavailable with preserved state.
tests.positive_control: Validated cell remains enabled.
